teaser: What does it cost, to see further than the room asks you to? You're a life path 11 who is also an ENFJ — the number that strains toward the unseen, carried by a type built to read the seen, the faces and tones in a room. The 11 wants to channel something larger; the ENFJ wants someone, specifically, lifted by it. Vision here stays a personal errand: never a doctrine, always aimed at this one person, this one evening, this one need in front of you.
